subject: Service-tier resync & fee alignment — proposed amendment for CloudWorks
messages:
From: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@cloudworks.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@cloudworks.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: amendment to increase throughput SKU + align fees

Sergio — thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement has reviewed our expected ramp and we'd like to request a short amendment to the MSA + order form to: 1) add a 25% throughput uplift (reserve additional dedicated throughput SKUs for Q3 ramp), 2) adjust the fee schedule for the new blended rate for the additional capacity, and 3) include a brief SOW exhibit that clarifies onboarding milestones for the higher throughput.

Attached is the SOW draft from our side (CloudWorks_SOW_v2.docx) showing target dates and an initial implementation window. We need a statement of commercial terms and a PO-ready amendment by next week (target: Jun 6) to get procurement sign-off. Can you loop in legal for redlines and a DocuSign path?

Also flagged: our security team asked whether the amendment can include a short sentence preserving existing data-residency commitments (EU customers unaffected) — we want to avoid a general data movement clause.

Appreciate quick confirmation of next steps.

Best,
Samantha
Samantha Nguyen
Head of Procurement, CloudWorks
[Attachment: CloudWorks_SOW_v2.docx (docx, 258KB)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: amendment to increase throughput SKU + align fees

Samantha — thanks, received the SOW. Looping in Laura (pricing/procurement lead) and Karthik (legal ops) to get a proposed amendment and redline back to you. High-level plan from our side:

- We’ll map the 25% uplift to a short-term reserved block (Q3 only) as a supplemental exhibit to the order form.
- Propose a blended fee for the uplift (midpoint between your committed tier and burst tier) — Laura will propose numbers.
- Karthik: can you confirm whether we need any language changes on data residency to explicitly call out EU carveouts?

Samantha — target is to share an internal redline + a PO-ready amendment (DocuSign link) by end of day Jun 2 so you have time for procurement review before Jun 6.

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: amendment to increase throughput SKU + align fees

Team — quick legal/pricing notes after initial read:

1) SOW: CloudWorks_SOW_v2 looks fine for milestones. I’ve prepared a short redline PDF (RW-Inference-redline-v1.pdf) that: adds an Exhibit X (Supplemental Throughput), inserts a short paragraph under Order Form fees for a "temporary uplift blended rate", and explicitly references the existing data residency section with an EU carveout sentence rather than broadening the residence clause.

2) Liability/indemnity: no change required given the uplift is capacity-only and short-term, but we should keep the indemnity cross-reference to Exhibit A (MSA).

3) Fallback routing clause: legal asks to preserve the current fallback policy where requests can be routed to a compatible variant if dedicated pool is exhausted — this is operational detail and should be preserved as-is to avoid SLA drift.

4) Approvals: if Laura signs off on the blended fee, I can finalize the redline and feed it into DocuSign.

Next actions: Laura to propose the blended rate; I’ll circulate the redline for internal sign-off by EOD Jun 2.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RW-Inference-redline-v1.pdf (pdf, 112KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: amendment to increase throughput SKU + align fees

Confirmed — proposed blended fee attached inline below and ready to go: 25% uplift mapped to 200 additional throughput units for Q3; blended rate = $0.0185 / unit (applied only to the uplift block). We are also offering a one-time onboarding credit of $8,000 to cover parallel run costs during the higher throughput ramp.

Karthik — please insert the blended rate and credit into the amendment exhibit. After your final redline, Sergio can send to Samantha with the DocuSign envelope.

Laura Bennett
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Samantha Nguyen <samantha.nguyen@cloudworks.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@cloudworks.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: amendment to increase throughput SKU + align fees

Samantha — thanks for your patience. Attached is our redline (RW-Inference-redline-v1.pdf) and a PO-ready amendment summary:

- Exhibit X: Temporary Throughput Uplift — 200 units reserved (Q3)
- Blended uplift rate: $0.0185 / unit applied to uplift block
- One-time onboarding credit: $8,000 applied on first invoice post-amendment
- Data residency: we include an explicit EU carveout sentence; no global residency changes
- Operational fallback: preserved as-is per MSA Exhibit A

DocuSign envelope (proposed): https://www.docusign.net/transaction/123abc456def
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/8901 (deal CW-2026-0891)

If the terms look good, please confirm and I’ll send the DocuSign. Also let us know PO timing — if you need the amendment signed by Jun 6 for procurement cycles, we can prioritize the envelope for next-day signature.

Thanks,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: RW-Inference-redline-v1.pdf (pdf, 112KB)]
